answer: Re-attestations are stored in summit and opal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 2 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 773 account sybil into a 7 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
